title: Atomic Semantic Firewall for System One Models: Exhaustive Atomic Rule-State Verification for High-Recall Semantic Quality Control
description: Technical note proposing Atomic Semantic Firewall (ASF), an architecture designed for System One Models. ASF compiles large natural-language knowledge assets into atomic semantic constraints and performs exhaustive or near-exhaustive rule-state verification over bounded local state windows, escalating anomalies to System Two reasoning.
